name: Shinobi, Koi Utsutsu -Kanmitsu Hana Emaki-
original_name: 忍び、恋うつつ ― 甘蜜花絵巻 ―
source: Sequel to Shinobi, Koi Utsutsu -Setsugekka Koi Emaki-. The fandisk features an after story of Kaede and her man graduating, joining Sanada Yuushitai and getting married.
translation: 《忍び、恋うつつ～雪月花恋絵巻～》的续作。本粉丝碟收录枫及其恋人毕业、加入真田勇士队并结婚后的故事。
